repos/example-outfitters/trail-planner.description: Plan multi-day hikes: routes, water, campsites and daily distances.
repos/example-outfitters/trail-planner.name: trail-planner

_default.body:
Planning the Kamchatka coast route (it crosses 180° longitude twice), the elevation chart shows a flat line at 0 m for every day after the first crossing.

**Steps**
1. Import `kamchatka-coast.gpx` (attached)
2. Open the Elevation tab

**Expected** the real profile.
**Actual** a flat line after day 2.

I suspect the segment splitter: longitudes jump from 179.9 to -179.9 and the distance comes out as almost the whole planet.
_default.title: Elevation profile is flat for routes that cross the antimeridian

_default.body:
Most watches and phone apps read GPX. Right now the only way out of the planner is a screenshot.

A first version could export the track and the campsites as waypoints. Elevation can come later.
_default.title: Export a planned route as GPX

_default.body:
With the region `Sierra High Route` saved for offline use, the app still fetches every tile again when I open it with a connection. On a metered plan that is 180 MB each time.

The cache folder is there and full, so it looks like the cache key changes between runs.
_default.title: Offline map tiles are downloaded again on every start

_default.body: At zoom 15 and above the blue water-drop markers cover the trail, so you can't see which side of the stream the path is on.
_default.title: Water source markers sit on top of the trail line at high zoom

_default.body: The checklist is the most-used screen with no translation yet. Strings live in `locales/en/checklist.json`.
_default.title: Translate the packing checklist into Spanish

_default.body: Importing a GPX file whose `<name>` element is empty closes the app. Renaming the track in the file first works around it.
_default.title: Crash when importing a route with an empty name

_default.body: People keep asking why a 14 km day is shown as 6 hours. The estimate uses Naismith's rule plus a pack-weight factor; we should say so on the Plan screen's help page.
_default.title: Docs: explain how the daily distance estimate is calculated

_default.body: The tent icon is dark grey on the dark map style. A light outline would fix it.
_default.title: Campsite icons are hard to read in dark mode
